experiments.scope: Exact sha3-256-r6-prefix-v1 on 64-byte single-block messages. Per organizer seed, 256 groups with SHA-256-derived 64-byte prefixes, one per bit position of a full 256-position batch, 2 messages each (z = gray(t), t = 0, 1; LE32(z) XORed into bytes 0..3 and 40..43), original layout capacity 512. Digests used for matching come only from the bitsliced grouped evaluator of proof.md Sections 4-5 (Gray-updated A2 from coefficient words on the 62-word support, bitsliced rounds 2-5, row-0 round 6, delta-swap transpose to 256-bit keys). The first pair agreeing on an 18-bit mask spread over digest lanes 0-3 is returned; failures return two nulls. In every trial the first 4 keys are checked at full 256-bit width against an independent direct 6-round sponge, and the z-dependence of A2 is checked to vanish outside the 62 support words; any failure aborts the run. Updated budget: only the first 510 messages in this fixed layout order participate; the final two are skipped. Thus N_t = 510 and N_t^2/2^18 = (255/256)^2, matching the full attack ratio.
experiments.hypothesis: For the fixed first 510 messages of this grouped layout, the masked success frequency is consistent, within sampling error, with the independent uniform 18-bit birthday model (approximately 0.3907), supporting but not proving H1 at full width.

experiments.scope: As k6r6-bs-full-width, but each trial has 16 groups of 32 messages (z = gray(t), t = 0..31, so A2 is Gray-updated on z bits 0..4); 16 trials share one 256-position batch, each owning 16 bit positions (bitwise operations never mix positions, so trials stay independent). 18-bit mask on digest bytes 2, 12, 21, 28. Same full-width exactness and support checks; any failure aborts the run. Updated budget: only the first 510 messages in this fixed layout order participate; the final two are skipped. Thus N_t = 510 and N_t^2/2^18 = (255/256)^2, matching the full attack ratio.

experiments.scope: As k6r6-bs-full-width, but all original layout capacity 512 messages of a trial lie in one group (one bit position; z = gray(t), t = 0..511, Gray updates on z bits 0..8): the strongest within-group structure, a negligible share of pairs at full scale. 256 trials share one batch. 18-bit mask on the top bits of digest lanes 0-3. Same full-width exactness and support checks; any failure aborts the run. Updated budget: only the first 510 messages in this fixed layout order participate; the final two are skipped.
